title: Vanilla Core Plus
description: A perfect base modpack to start new Minecraft instances with improved performance, visuals, and quality of life while staying true to vanilla.
body:
# Vanilla Core Plus

✨ **Vanilla Core Plus** is a lightweight base modpack that improves performance, visuals, and quality of life while staying true to the vanilla Minecraft experience.

It is designed as the perfect starting point for new Minecraft instances or custom modpacks.

---

## 🚀 Features
- ⚡ Performance improvements
- 🧹 Quality of life enhancements
- 🎨 Visual improvements
- 📦 Lightweight and fast
- 🌿 Vanilla-friendly gameplay
- 🧱 Perfect base for custom modpacks
- 🌍 Ideal for servers and singleplayer

---

## 🎯 Perfect for
- Starting a new Minecraft world
- Multiplayer servers
- Building your own modpack
- Vanilla+ experience
- Low-end PCs
- Stable long-term worlds

---

## 🧠 Philosophy
Vanilla Core Plus does not try to change Minecraft.  
It tries to **improve the foundation**.

**Better performance.  
Cleaner experience.  
Still vanilla.**

---

## 🔧 Add your own mods
This pack is intentionally lightweight so you can easily add:
- Content mods
- World generation mods
- Tech mods
- Magic mods
- Client-side mods

Use it as your **core base** for every new Minecraft instance.
